letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or the soft evening breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful life with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. Even when the world spins fast, I pause to thank the stars for the day we said “I do” on that magical February. You’re my forever cutie, my partner in adventure, and the love that makes every moment feel like a sweet, endless spring.
poem:
In every city’s glow you’re my bright light,  
Your love turns ordinary days to pure delight.  
Across dunes or rivers, my heart stays true,  
Forever yours, forever me, just me and you.
